cnn_augmentation: per-image flip and batch rotation ±10 degrees
mobile_architecture: torchvision MobileNetV3 Small ImageNet1K V1, classifier removed; 576 pooled features
mobile_transform: official weights.transforms(): resize 256, center crop224, ImageNet normalize; one additional horizontal flip per training image
mobile_head: StandardScaler + multinomial LogisticRegression max_iter3000; original and flipped training embeddings
selection: Highest validation macro F1; earliest epoch/trial on ties; compare against unchanged C2 validation score
test_policy: All candidates and selected checkpoints frozen before any test images loaded; evaluate each CNN trial winner and selected MobileNet head once. Reused test set, no further tuning from test.
